newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to form China car parts venture.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to form China car parts venture.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday it would soon set up a joint venture in China to produce steering and drive shafts.
The company, to be formed with a group company of Tianjin Automotive Industrial Corp, will be Toyota's fourth car parts venture in China, a Toyota spokeswoman said.
The company will supply steering and drive shafts for the Charade, which is made by Tianjin with technical assistance from Daihatsu Motor Co Ltd. Toyota owns 33.4 percent of Daihatsu.
